Package hadur2.core.melee

Class EnemyHistory

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.EnemyHistory
public final class EnemyHistory extends Object
One opponent's movement for the FieldGun: the scans of this round, and a battle-long kd-tree of situations (the melee attribute set) each paired with how the opponent moved over the next HORIZON ticks, relative to its heading then (MGUN-1).

A situation joins the tree once a scan HORIZON ticks later has arrived, or at the round's end with whatever followed it. Each trajectory is stored as the later scans' (ticks, forward, sideways) offsets, so the gun plays it forward by interpolation. The tree is the melee gun's own; the duel's trees never see melee data.
